title: Batch intervention demo
prompt: How should a small civic team balance bridge exposure against overload in a pilot cycle?

contributions.body: Bridge exposure should surface one relevant but non-obvious perspective in each digest.
Load budgets should keep the digest compact enough to finish in one sitting.
contributions.evidenceText: Completion rates drop when reading burden expands.

contributions.body: The operator needs readable export artifacts after the cycle closes.
contributions.evidenceText: Pilot review depends on legible evidence.

responses.body: The load budget matters, but the digest should still show one contrasting view.
